name: Microsoft Excel UI Ontology
description: Comprehensive hierarchical ontology and semantic UI registry for the Microsoft Excel desktop application on Windows.

source_provenance.secondary: Windows UI Automation Accessibility Tree & Microsoft Office GUI Specifications

layout_regions.name: Quick Access Toolbar & Title Bar
layout_regions.description: Top bar with AutoSave, Save, Undo, Redo, Workbook Title, Search bar, and Window controls.

layout_regions.name: Ribbon Header Tabs Bar
layout_regions.description: Horizontal tabs: File, Home, Insert, Draw, Page Layout, Formulas, Data, Review, View, Automate, Help.

layout_regions.name: Ribbon Lower Command Band
layout_regions.description: Grouped command icons (e.g. Tables, Illustrations, Add-ins, Charts, PivotTables, Sparklines, Filters, Links).

layout_regions.name: Name Box & Formula Bar
layout_regions.description: Name Box on the left (e.g. 'A1'), Insert Function (fx) button, and the expanding text Formula Bar.

layout_regions.name: Worksheet Spreadsheet Grid Area
layout_regions.description: Main scrollable cell grid with column headers (A, B, C...) and row numbers (1, 2, 3...).

layout_regions.name: Sheet Tabs & Status Bar
layout_regions.description: Bottom bar showing sheet selector (Sheet1, +), Ready state, Macro recorder, Average/Count/Sum stats, Page views, and Zoom slider.

visual_features: Rectangular grid cells containing numeric and text tabular data
When highlighted: filled with light green/gray overlay and bounded by dark green selection outline with fill-handle square in bottom-right corner

ui_changes: Name box updates to top-left cell coordinate (e.g. 'A1')
Quick Analysis icon (lightning bolt) appears at the bottom-right corner of the selection box

visual_features: Text tab labeled 'Insert' located between 'Home' and 'Page Layout' / 'Draw' in the top Ribbon tabs row

ui_changes: Ribbon lower command band updates to show Insert groups: Tables, Illustrations, Add-ins, Charts, Tours, Sparklines, Filters, Links, Comments, Text, Symbols

visual_features: Medium/large ribbon button with chart icon and green checkmark/magnifier with label 'Recommended Charts'
Located in the 'Charts' ribbon group on the Insert tab

ui_changes: Modal dialog titled 'Insert Chart' appears on screen with tabs 'Recommended Charts' and 'All Charts'
Preview thumbnails of Clustered Column, Bar, Line, and Pie charts displayed on the left

visual_features: Ribbon button with vertical bar chart icon located directly next to Recommended Charts in the Charts group

ui_changes: Flyout gallery opens showing 2-D Column (Clustered, Stacked), 3-D Column, 2-D Bar, and 3-D Bar options

visual_features: Rendered floating graphic object with axes, title, data series bars/lines, and legend
When selected: surrounded by border with 8 circular handles, and floating quick-buttons appear on top-right: '+' (Chart Elements), paintbrush (Chart Styles), and funnel (Chart Filters)
Ribbon activates two contextual tabs: 'Chart Design' and 'Format'

ui_changes: Chart Design and Format ribbon tabs become visible in green header highlight

visual_features: Funnel icon with A-Z letters in the Editing group of the Home tab (or Sort & Filter group in Data tab)

ui_changes: Dropdown arrows appear on each column header of the selected dataset table

visual_features: Large ribbon button at far left of Insert tab showing spreadsheet table with colored rows and blue header

ui_changes: Dialog 'PivotTable from table or range' appears asking for destination worksheet
